title: Scenario 1 knowledge check
notes: PROVISIONAL INSTRUMENT. These items were drafted for the FarmSim prototype and have NOT been reviewed or approved by a supervisor. Review and revise before any study use. Editing this file is enough to change the instrument - no code changes are required.

questions.text: On the farm you just worked, what had to happen to a tile before seed could be sown in it?
options: Nothing, seed can go into any tile
It had to be tilled first
It had to be watered first
It had to be treated for pests first
questions.explanation: Untilled ground rejected the seed. Preparing the seedbed came first, which is why the two roles had to work in sequence.

questions.text: A sown tile stopped making progress even though nothing had gone wrong with pests. What was the most likely reason?
options: Its moisture had fallen too low
It was planted too close to the water source
questions.explanation: Growth only runs at full speed while a tile has enough moisture. A tile that dries out slows down and then starts losing condition.

questions.text: Why could one player not have finished the season alone?
options: The field is too large for one person to walk
Only one role can till and sow, and only the other can scout and treat
The game blocks a single player from moving
One player runs out of water sooner
questions.explanation: The tools are split between the two roles on purpose, so the season only finishes if both players do their part.
